name: gk-question-pictures
description: Builds img/questions/*.svg. Run: npm install; download the three Natural Earth files (v5.1.2 geojson: ne_110m_admin_0_countries, ne_50m_rivers_lake_centerlines, ne_50m_lakes) into ./ne; node build.mjs ../../img/questions; then from the repo root: node tools/question-pictures/attach.js
